raw_segments.text: I do know her spirit, and will not trust one of her malice with a drug of such damned nature.
Those she has will stupefy and dull the sense a while, which first perchance she'll prove
on cats and dogs, then afterward up higher.
But there is no danger in what show of death it makes, more than the locking up the spirits
a time, to be more fresh, reviving.
She is fooled with a most false effect, and I the truer so to be false with her.
